title: Image text wrap odt 001
notes: real anchored picture with text around it: deterministic solid-color 160x120 PNG (PIL, no rng needed) at Pictures/wrap1.png (manifest media-type image/png) inside draw:frame > draw:image, paragraph-anchored (text:anchor-type="paragraph") via an automatic family="graphic" style GpFloat1 carrying style:paragraph-anchor + paragraph-relative x/y positions and style:wrap-influence-on-position="once"; the frame sits inside a paragraph whose runs continue after it, six filler paragraphs follow. Honest caveat: ODF wrap semantics (whether text actually flows beside the frame) are renderer-policy territory — LibreOffice wrap behavior may vary with anchor/wrap settings; reference text is every visible paragraph string in order.
